subject: The 2AM build that changed how I code
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but... what I built at 2AM might be the only thing you need today.
body_paragraphs: I woke up at 2AM last Tuesday. Not from a nightmare — just my brain grinding on something. I opened my laptop and wrote a single line of code that changed how I think about this app. It wasn't a feature. It was a removal.

I deleted the ad SDK from the free version. Just yanked it. Because I realized something: you didn't download Volume Booster Pro to be sold to. You downloaded it to turn up your podcasts and get back to your life. The ads were a wall between you and that moment.

So here's what that 2AM build became: the same +200% boost, zero interstitials, zero notifications. The slider, the EQ, and nothing else. It auto-applies when your headphones connect, then vanishes. No nags. No game layer. Just quiet utility — like your alarm clock used to be.

Open the app today. Tap the headphone icon to set it to auto-apply. Then forget it exists. That's the point. P.S. — I'm keeping this build as a hidden version for users who email me. Reply to this email with '2AM' and I'll send you the link. No strings.
